plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Mechanical Engineering BS graduation plan text PDF ('Graduation Plan - 4 years'; alternate 5-year plans for MATH 1010/MATH 1050 starters also in the PDF are NOT transcribed — only the standard 4-year plan). Semester totals as printed: 15 / 16 / 18 / 15.5 / 14.5 / 16.5 / 15 / 15 = 125.5, matching the printed 'Total Hours 125.5'. Lecture+lab pairs printed on combined rows are modeled as single combined entries per the source's own hour groupings. Course titles verified against the program's 2025-2026 curriculum (mechanical-engineering-bs_text.pdf): CHEM 1210 Principles of Chemistry I (PS); PHYS 2210 Physics/Scientists Engineers I (PS); PHYS 2220 Physics/Scientists Engineers II; MECH 1000 Introduction to Design & Rapid Prototyping; MECH 1100 Manufacturing Processes; MECH 1150 Prototyping Techniques; MECH 1200 Coding; MECH 2010 Statics; MECH 2030 Dynamics; MECH 2160 Materials Science; MECH 2210 Circuits; MECH 2250 Sensors & Actuators; MECH 3200 Systems & Controls; MECH 3250 Machinery; MECH 3300 Strength of Materials; MECH 3600 Thermodynamics; MECH 3650 Heat Transfer; MECH 3700 Fluid Mechanics; MECH 4000 Product Design I; MECH 4010 Product Design II; MATH 1210 Calculus I (MA); MATH 1220 Calculus II (MA); MATH 2210 Multivariable Calculus (MA); MATH 2250 Differential Equations and Linear Algebra; MATH 3500 Numerical Analysis; ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN); ENGL 3010 Professional Writing and Business Ethics. 'Tech Elective (N)' slots are choice placeholders (numbered 1-4); catalog: complete 12 credits from any MECH 4xxx (excl. 4000/4010), any ECE 4xxx (excl. 4000/4005/4010/4015), any MTRN 4xxx (excl. 4000/4010); max 3 cr research/design practicum; 6 cr must carry MECH prefix. 'FE Exam' is a 0-credit graduation requirement (pass the Fundamentals of Engineering Exam), modeled as required_zero. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
